title: 機械工学専門実験・演習A
subtitle: Mechanical Engineering Major Lab/Exercises A
keywords: Materials for mechanical engineering 2.Mechanical processing 3.Manufacturing system 4.Thermodynamics 5.Internal combustion engine
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Acquire sufficient understanding and application of the following specialized subjects: materials for mechanical engineering, mechanical processing, manufacturing systems, thermodynamics, and internal combustion engine. (2) Acquire technical writing skills. (3) Learn how to create presentation materials and presentation scripts.
advice: We will cover the following topics: Materials for mechanical engineering: microstructure, hardness testing, and X-ray diffraction testing Mechanical processing: cutting conditions, tool geometry, cutting force, and surface finish Manufacturing systems: numerical control (NC), NC lathe, and NC simulator Thermodynamics: temperature measurement, heat pump, and coefficient of performance Internal combustion engine: thermal efficiency, emissions, and diesel cycle Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are expected to check for various messages and materials in class. Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts.
requiredKnowledge: Preview and review related specialized subjects. Create and submit technical preparatory reports before each experimental class. Have basic knowledge of related specialized subjects. Know how to use a calculator and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).

activityGoals.body: Be able to summarize the experimental results.
Be able to actively participate in experiments based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to consider the experimental results based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to evaluate the experimental results based on your knowledge of related specialized subjects.
Be able to use the kinematics model to determine the relationship between experimental and theoretical results.
Be able to submit and explain your experimental results as a technical report.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Create thorough technical reports on experimental results using a computer. (2) Proactively participate systematically in class experiments based on the related specialized subjects. (3) Consider and evaluate your experimental results according to the related specialized subjects. (4) Use the kinematics model to compare experimental and theoretical results. (5) Explain experimental results in a thorough technical report and submit it for evaluation.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Create technical reports on experimental results using a computer. (2) Participate in class experiments based on related specialized subjects. (3) Consider and evaluate the experimental results according to the related specialized subjects. (4) Compare the relationship between experimental and theoretical results. (5) Explain experimental results in a technical report and submit it for evaluation.

lessons.content: Experiments in Materials for Mechanical Engineering (1): Influence of Optical Microstructures on Hardness Conduct hardness testing and optical microscope observation of metals for a machine structure. Discuss the relationship between macrostructure, hardness, and heat treatment.
lessons.assignments: Prepare the technical preparatory reports Create 1st technical reports

lessons.content: Experiments in Materials for Mechanical Engineering (2): Influence of Crystal Structures on Processing Perform X-ray diffraction tests of standard materials (e.g., Si and Fe) and typical metals for machine structures. Discuss the relationship between microstructure (such as crystal structure and lattice constant) and heat treatment.

Experiments in Materials for Mechanical Engineering (3) As a summary of this experiment, take an oral examination for final report preparation. Self-check Review the content learned in the experiment, self-check the final report, and use it for future study planning.
lessons.operation: Lecture, experimental activities, and Q&A Self-check and self-reflection

lessons.content: Experiments in Mechanical Processing (1) Effect of tool geometry on cutting force and machined surface Evaluate cutting characteristics in four groups. Select the optimum conditions from the experimental results using the cutting edge angle and nose radius as parameters.
lessons.assignments: Prepare the technical preparatory reports Create 1st technical reports

lessons.content: Experiments in Mechanical Processing (2) Effect of cutting conditions on cutting force and machined surface Evaluate cutting characteristics in four groups. Select the optimum conditions from the results using the cutting speed and feed rate as parameters.
Experiments in Mechanical Processing (3) Review reports summarizing experimental results and considerations conducted in classes 4 and 5.
lessons.operation: Lecture, experimental activities, and Q&A Self-check and self-reflection

lessons.content: Experiments in Manufacturing Systems (1) Learn about NC programming and operation of the NC simulator. Participate in team activity to machine a workpiece with an NC lathe.
lessons.assignments: Prepare the technical preparatory reports Create 1st technical reports

lessons.content: Experiments in Manufacturing Systems (2) Team presentation on an NC program and its productivity. Preparation for the intermediate report.

Experiments in Manufacturing Systems (3) Evaluate accuracy of the machined workpiece. Prepare for the final report. Self-check Review the content learned in the experiment, self-check the final report, and prepare for future study.
lessons.operation: Lecture, experimental activities, and Q&A Self-check and self- reflection

lessons.content: Experiments in Thermodynamics (1) Perform a heat pump performance test using a the rmocouple.
lessons.assignments: Prepare the technical preparatory reports Create 1st technical reports

lessons.content: Experiments in Thermodynamics (2) Perform a heat pump performance test using a radiation thermometer.
Experiments in Thermodynamics (3) Review the experimental results up to the previous class.
lessons.operation: Lecture, experimental activities, and Q&A Self-check and self-reflection

lessons.content: Experiments in Evaluation of Internal Combustion Engines (1) Perform performance tests under constant speed conditions.
lessons.assignments: Prepare the technical preparatory reports Create 1st technical reports

lessons.content: Experiments in Evaluation of Internal Combustion Engines (2) Review and discuss the experimental results.
Experiments in Evaluation of Internal Combustion Engines (3) Make a presentation and participate in discussions on internal combustion engine technologies.
lessons.operation: Lecture, experimental activities, and Q&A Self-check and self-reflection
